title.narrative: Program Continuation - Elimination of Malaria in Southern Africa - Africa - Multicountry Southern Africa MOSASWA (01-Jan-2023-31-Dec-2025)

description.narrative: Multicountry Southern Africa MOSASWA, Malaria, Lubombo Spatial Development Initiative 2 NPC (LSDI-2)This program has the following goals: To work collaboratively as public and private sector to accelerate on the pathway to subnational elimination in southern Mozambique (by reducing incidence and prevalence by 40% from the 2021 baseline by 2025) and achieve elimination of malaria in Eswatini and South Africa by 2025.. The objectives of this program are: To continue strengthen the MOSASWA malaria cross- border initiative to coordinate, harmonise policies, strengthen sub- national capacity and share expertise and strategic information among the three countries to accelerate to the goal of malaria elimination.. To ensure high coverage of malaria elimination interventions across the epidemiologically connected MOSASWA region, with prioritized targeting of the highest risk localities and mobile and migrant population (MMPs).. To strengthen monitoring and evaluation and operational research to identify gaps and inform policy and needs in elimination efforts; and generate evidence for data driven decision making.. To mobilise resources and advocate for increased and sustainable malaria financing to achieve and sustain malaria elimination.
